name: Doi Sakuya
source:
She is a girl from a dairy farm family in Tokachi, Hokkaido. She changed her appearance when she entered the school because she didn't like being called a country girl.

She is a cheerful and energetic mood-maker who is popular with both men and women alike. However, she is embarrassed by her Hokkaido dialect and tries her best to hide it.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/saimin/index.html]official site[/url]]
